original: ねえ、コレット？\nコレットは、天使……なのよね？
traducao: Hey, Colette?\nYou're an angel... right?

original: 羽があるのに、飛んだりしないで\n私達と同じ様に生活をしているのね
traducao: Even with wings, you don't fly around\nand live just like the rest of us.

original: うん、そだよ
traducao: Yep, that's right!

original: 飛ぶ事もあるけど……でも\nやっぱり、一緒がいいから
traducao: I fly sometimes... but still,\nbeing together with everyone is best.

original: 一緒がいい？
traducao: Being together is best?

original: ねえ、その「一緒がいい」相手って\nもしかして男の子？
traducao: Say, that person you want to be with...\ncould it be a boy?

original: えっ？　\nど、どうして？
traducao: Huh?\nH-How did you know?

original: 女の勘よ、勘。\nそれで、どうなの？　\n本当のところは？
traducao: A woman's intuition!\nSo, how about it?\nWhat's the real story?

original: う……うん
traducao: U-Um... yeah.

original: やっぱり、そうだったのね
traducao: I knew it, it really was!

original: ねえコレット、今度あなたの部屋に\n泊りに行ってもいい？
traducao: Hey Colette, can I come have\na sleepover in your room sometime?

original: 私、もっとコレットの話を聞きたいな
traducao: I want to hear more from you, Colette!

original: うん、いいよ
traducao: Sure, I'd love that!

original: 良かった。\nじゃあ、約束ね
traducao: Wonderful!\nThen it's a promise.

original: えへへ……。\nうん、約束
traducao: Ehehe...\nYep, it's a promise.

original: シェリアの分のお布団、\n用意して待ってるね
traducao: I'll have bedding ready\nand wait for you, Cheria!

original: ありがとう。\nじゃあ、私は枕も\n持って行っちゃおうかな
traducao: Thank you!\nIn that case, maybe I'll bring\nmy own pillow along too!

original: 困ったねえ……。\nどんなものがいいだろう
traducao: This is tricky...\nWhat should we make?

original: そうね。\nすぐ思い浮かぶものは\n大体もう作ってしまったし……
traducao: Yes.\nWe've already made most things\nthat come to mind right away...

original: それじゃ、焼き鳥丼なんかはどう？
traducao: In that case, how about yakitori bowls?

original: スタミナも付くし、タレを工夫すれば\n結構飽きが来ないものよ
traducao: It builds stamina, and with good sauce,\npeople won't get tired of it easily.

original: 焼き鳥丼か……
traducao: A yakitori bowl, huh...

original: うん。\nいいんじゃないかい？
traducao: Yeah.\nSounds pretty good to me!

original: お肉のバリエーションを増やせば\n今後も色んなメニューを楽しめそうね
traducao: If we vary the kinds of meat,\nwe can enjoy many different menus too.

original: 私もシェリアさんの案に賛成です
traducao: I agree with Cheria's suggestion as well.

original: じゃあ、今晩の献立は\n焼き鳥丼で決まりね。\n問題は材料だけど……
traducao: Then tonight's menu is decided\nas yakitori bowls.\nThe only issue is ingredients...

original: それなら心配いらないよ
traducao: No need to worry about that!

original: リッドやカイウス達に頼んで、\n材料をたくさん\n獲ってきてもらえばいいんだ
traducao: We can just ask Reid, Caius, and the rest\nto go hunt down\nplenty of ingredients for us!

original: みんな、そんな事まで\n協力してくれるの？
traducao: Will everyone really help out\nwith that sort of thing?

original: ええ、そうなの。\n自然と役割分担が出来ていて……
traducao: Yes, indeed.\nRoles divided naturally like that...

original: こういう時、ここは男性が多いから\n助かっているわ
traducao: At times like this, having many men here\nis quite a blessing.

original: ああ。\n伊達に食料を\n消費してもらってるわけじゃないよ
traducao: Yeah.\nThey're not devouring our food supply\njust for show, you know!

original: 働かざる者、食うべからずさ
traducao: Those who don't work, don't eat!

original: ったく、あの暴力女……。\n今度も思いっきり関節きめやがって……
traducao: Good grief, that violent woman...\nPutting me in a joint lock again...

original: ッ！　\n痛っててて……！！
traducao: Gah!\nOw-ow-ow-ow-ow...!!

original: ロニ！
traducao: Loni!

original: 大丈夫？\n足がふらふらじゃない
traducao: Are you alright?\nYour legs are wobbling!

original: ああ……悪いなシェリア。\n今日のはちっとばかし強烈だったぜ……
traducao: Yeah... Sorry, Cheria.\nToday's was a bit extra brutal...

original: イテテテ……
traducao: Ow-ow-ow...

original: ……ねえ、ロニ？
traducao: ...Say, Loni?

original: 何だ？
traducao: What is it?

original: ロニはナナリーが好きなの？
traducao: Do you like Nanaly, Loni?

original: ぶほぉっ！？
traducao: Bwah!?

original: な、何言って……
traducao: Wh-What are you saying...

original: だって、これだけ毎回やられてても\nロニはナナリーの事避けたり\n嫌いになったりしないのよね
traducao: Even after being beaten like this,\nyou never avoid Nanaly\nor hate her, do you?

original: それってやっぱり、そこにロマンスが……∀
traducao: Doesn't that mean there's romance...? :)

original: ない！　\nそんなものは断じてないぞ！！
traducao: There isn't!\nThere is absolutely nothing like that!!

original: ううん、隠してもだめ。\n私にはわかるんだから！
traducao: No, no use hiding it.\nI can see right through you!

original: 何がだーー！！
traducao: See through WHAT!?!

original: なるほど……
traducao: I see......

original: 確かに、そういった救護活動の事例は\nオルタ・ビレッジにとっても\n有益な情報になりそうだ
traducao: Indeed, such examples of relief work\nlook to be very useful information\nfor Aulter Village as well.

original: 協力感謝するよ、シェリア
traducao: Thanks for your help, Cheria.

original: どういたしまして。\n少しでも役に立てたなら良かったわ
traducao: You're very welcome.\nI'm glad if I could be of any help.

original: でも、随分大がかりな事を\nやろうとしているのね。\nキールが一人で取り仕切っているの？
traducao: Still, you're undertaking quite\na massive project, Keele.\nAre you managing it all on your own?

original: いや、一応\nメルディもメンバーなんだが……。\nあいつは色々あってな……
traducao: No, Meredy is technically\na member as well, but...\nShe's a handful in many ways...

original: 色々って？
traducao: A handful in what way?

original: 学習意欲や前向きな気持ちは認めるが、\n成果よりコミュニケーションに\n比重を置き過ぎる
traducao: Her eagerness to learn is fine, but\nshe prioritizes socializing\nway over getting actual results.

original: 少しは自分の立場というものを……
traducao: She should consider her position a bit...

original: もしかして、\nそれって嫉妬してるっていう事？
traducao: Could it be...\nthat you're actually jealous?

original: 嫉妬！？\nバカな、そんなわけ……
traducao: Jealous!?\nRidiculous, no way could that...

original: でも、他の人と仲良くしてるのが\n気になるんでしょう？
traducao: Yet you can't stand her getting along\nwith other people, can you?

original: 違う！　\nただ……その……\n色々込み入った事情があって……！
traducao: That's not it!\nIt's just... well...\nThere are complicated circumstances...!

original: ええ、そうよね……
traducao: Yes, of course...

original: その事情というのを、もう少し詳しく\n聞かせてもらえないかしら？
traducao: Could you tell me a little more\nabout those circumstances?

original: だから……、\nそんなに期待に満ちた目で見ないでくれ！\n誤解なんだ〜〜！！
traducao: I told you...!\nDon't look at me with such hopeful eyes!\nIt's a misunderstanding~~~!!

original: なぁ、リタ
traducao: Hey, Rita.

original: ……何よ
traducao: ...What?

original: 忙しいから、後に……
traducao: I'm busy, so later...

original: もしかして、\nフレン隊長の事が嫌いなのか？
traducao: Could it be...\nyou dislike Captain Flynn?

original: 何となく、避けてる様に\n見えるけど……
traducao: Somehow, it looks like\nyou've been avoiding him...

original: 嫌いっていうか……、\n見ててイライラするだけよ
traducao: It's not that I dislike him...\nHe just gets on my nerves.

original: 頭固いくせして、\nやる事甘いっていうか。\n中途半端なのよね、あいつ
traducao: He's completely stiff-necked, yet\nhe acts so soft-hearted.\nHe does everything halfway.

original: 確かに、融通の利かないところはあるけど\n隊長は筋の通らない事はしない。\nリタの件だってそうだったじゃないか
traducao: True, he can be inflexible at times, but\nthe Captain never acts unreasonably.\nWasn't that true with you as well?

original: ああ、そうでしょうね。\nお優しい隊長で結構ですこと
traducao: Yeah, sure, whatever.\nGood for you and your gentle Captain.

original: わからないなぁ……
traducao: I just don't get it...

original: アスベル、どうだった？
traducao: Asbel, how did it go?

original: だめだよ、シェリア。\nあんまり話したくないみたいだ
traducao: No luck, Cheria.\nShe didn't seem to want to talk much.

original: よっぽど隊長と\n相性が悪いのかな……
traducao: I guess she and the Captain\njust really don't get along...

original: そんな事ないわよ。\nそれだけ反応するって事は、\nきっと気がある証拠よ
traducao: That's not it at all!\nReacting that strongly is proof\nshe definitely has feelings for him!

original: そうかなぁ……
traducao: I wonder...

original: そうよ。　意識するから、\n余計に気持ちが落ち着かなくなるの。\n間違いないわ！！
traducao: Because she's conscious of him,\nit makes her even more restless.\nI have no doubt about it!!

original: シェリア……もしかして\n楽しんでないか？
traducao: Cheria... could you perhaps\nbe enjoying this?

original: そ、そんな事ないわよ！
traducao: Th-That's not true at all!

original: 私はただ、同じ仲間なんだし\n仲良くして欲しいだけなんだから
traducao: Since we're all comrades here, I just\nwant everyone to get along, that's all!

original: （本当かなぁ……）
traducao: (I wonder if that's true...)

original: ポリポリ……
traducao: *scratch* *scratch*...

original: ソフィ、あなた\nちゃんとお風呂に入ってる？
traducao: Sophie, are you\ntaking baths properly?

original: うん……。\n入ってるよ、シェリア
traducao: Yeah...\nI'm taking them, Cheria.

original: 本当？\n最後に入ったのはいつ？
traducao: Really?\nWhen was the last time you took one?
...\nThree days ago...?

original: だめよ！　\nそんな不潔なの！
traducao: No, that won't do!\nThat's far too unhygienic!

original: 私がキレイに洗ってあげる。\nさ、一緒にお風呂行きましょ
traducao: I will wash you nice and clean.\nCome, let's go to the bath together.

original: うん……
traducao: Yeah...

original: シェリーってさぁ、\n何かおばさんっぽいよね〜
traducao: Cherie, ya know,\nyou kinda act like an old lady~
What!?

original: ……ど……どの辺りが……かしら？
traducao: ...I-In what way... exactly?

original: こないだもさ〜、ソフィたんに\n「風呂入れ〜」とか言ってたじゃん。\nそういうとこ？
traducao: Like the other day, you told Sophie-kins\nto take a bath and all that, right?\nStuff like that, ya know?

original: それって、何かおかしい事……なの？
traducao: Is there... something strange about that?

original: おかしいとかじゃなくて〜。\nこう、生活臭漂ってるって感じ？
traducao: It's not about being strange~\nIt's like... you smell of domestic life?

original: まぁ、そういうノーマさんが、\nひどく幼いのは確かですけどね
traducao: Well, it's undeniable that Norma-san\nherself is terribly childish, though.

original: なぬ〜！？　\nこんガキ！
traducao: Whaaat!?\nYou little brat!

original: そうやってすぐ怒るとこなんて\nまさに、じゃないですか
traducao: Getting mad right away like that\njust proves my point, doesn't it?

original: あんたが怒らす様な事\n言ってんでしょーがっ！！
traducao: Because you said something\nto deliberately piss me off!!

original: （お、おばさん……。\n　私って、そうなの……？）
traducao: (An o-old lady...\n Am I really like that...?)

original: ……時にシェリア、質問があるのだが
traducao: ...Cheria, I have a question for you.

original: 何かしら？
traducao: What might that be?

original: その……誤解を招く様な行動を\nしているなら、改めたいんだ。\nだから、教えてくれ
traducao: Well... if I'm doing anything misleading,\nI wish to correct my behavior.\nSo please tell me.

original: どうして、私がクーリッジに\n特別な感情を持っていると\n誤解が生まれたのだ？
traducao: Why did people get the misunderstanding\nthat I harbor special feelings\nfor Coolidge?

original: いいのよ、気にしないで。\nあなたは自然体でいるのが\n一番魅力的なのよ！
traducao: It's fine, don't worry about it.\nYou being your natural self\nis what makes you most charming!

original: 周りの目や意見なんか気にしちゃダメ。\nクロエはクロエらしく、ね。\nファイト！
traducao: Don't worry about what others think.\nJust be yourself, Chloe.\nFight on!

original: ま、まあ……自然体では\nいるつもりだが……
traducao: W-Well... I do intend\nto be my natural self, but...

original: だから、そのままでいいのよ
traducao: So you're great just the way you are!

original: 困った事とか、悩みがあったら、\n今みたいに遠慮しないで、\nいつでも私に相談してね
traducao: If you have troubles or worries,\ndon't hesitate like today,\ncome consult me anytime, okay?

original: ……？　\nわ、わかった
traducao: ...?\nU-Understood.

original: シェリアは、色々と\n心配してくれているだけなのだな。\nすまない……恩に着る
traducao: So you were merely worrying, Cheria,\nabout all sorts of things for me.\nI apologize... and thank you.

original: いいのよ、気にしないで
traducao: Don't mention it, think nothing of it!
(Ufufu... :) )

original: フレンさん……ですよね？\nいつもアスベルがお世話になっています
traducao: You're Flynn-san... right?\nThanks for always looking after Asbel.

original: そんな、とんでもない。\nむしろ彼には、こっちが\n助けられているくらいだよ
traducao: Not at all, don't mention it.\nIf anything, he is the one\nwho has been helping me out.

original: ……。\nあの……お聞きしたい事があるんです
traducao: ...\nUm... there's something I'd like to ask.

original: アスベルは……\n騎士として立派に、\n務めを果たせているんでしょうか
traducao: Is Asbel...\nfulfilling his duties admirably\nas a knight?

original: もちろん。\nアスベルはとても誠実で、真面目だ。\nそして正義感が強い
traducao: Of course.\nAsbel is deeply sincere and earnest.\nAnd he has a strong sense of justice.

original: そう遠くない未来に、\n騎士団の未来を担う人物に\nなってくれると思っているよ
traducao: In the not-too-distant future,\nI believe he will become someone who\nshoulders the future of the knights.

original: そうなんですか……
traducao: Is that so...?

original: （アスベル……騎士団でもずっと\n　頑張り続けていたのね……。\n　子どもの頃からの夢、だったものね……）
traducao: (Asbel... you kept giving it your all\n even in the knighthood...\n It was your dream since childhood...)

original: 気になるなら、本人に\n直接聞いてみてはどうだい？
traducao: If you're curious, why don't you\nask him yourself directly?

original: あ……いえ、いいんです。\nちょっと聞いてみたかっただけですから！
traducao: Ah... no, it's fine.\nI just wanted to ask a little, is all!

original: シェリアって、アスベルと\n幼馴染みなんだよね？
traducao: Cheria, you're childhood friends\nwith Asbel, right?

original: そうよ
traducao: That's right.

original: いいなぁ、あんなかっこいい\n幼馴染みがいるなんて！\nこれぞ、騎士！　って感じだもんね
traducao: Must be nice having such a cool\nchildhood friend!\nHe really feels like a true knight!

original: 昔からモテるタイプだったんじゃない？\n騎士団にいた頃とか……
traducao: Was he always popular with girls?\nLike back when he was in the knights...

original: ……騎士団にいた頃の事は……\nよく知らないの
traducao: ...About his time in the knighthood...\nI don't really know much.

original: え？　\nそうなの？
traducao: Huh?\nReally?

original: 小さい頃、騎士になる！　って言って\n一人で村を飛び出したのよ
traducao: When he was young, he said he'd become\na knight, and ran away from home alone.

original: それから、７年間……。\nずっと連絡は取っていなかったから
traducao: And for seven years after that...\nwe were never in touch at all.

original: あ……そう、なんだ
traducao: Ah... I see...

original: そんな顔しないで。\n昔の事だもの。\n別に、気にしてないから
traducao: Don't make that face.\nIt's all in the past.\nI really don't mind at all.

original: ……ほんとに、気にしてないから
traducao: ...Really, I don't mind at all.

traducao: Normal.\n

traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.
